rationale: With 15 cases, block any paired quality regression, require both refusals, >=90% absolute accuracy and >=85% agreement on 8 authored judge labels. For latency, block p95 above 60s or above max(10s, 2x baseline). The 10s floor prevents a single hosted-service outlier dominating p95 of a tiny sample; identical-config live runs measured 3.14s and 7.53s p95. Token ceiling remains 1.75x baseline.
